reviewer: Codex source-preservation review, not anatomical approval
method: Opened and inspected both newly generated native-frame and isolated source projection images using view_image; source vertices/connectivity unchanged.
findings: Four surfaces visibly faceted and thin curved artist bands. Transverse/descending iliofemoral source objects are distinct, not newly split from one mesh.
Anterior iliofemoral objects and posterior ischiofemoral source band remain in the supplied hip-bone/femur frame. No anatomical endpoint or attachment boundary validation performed.
Pubofemoral object is a curved narrow band. None of the images establish recess cavity geometry, synovial tissue, a measured thickness or segmented subject volume.
